title: Ferruginous
summary: FERRU'GINOUS, adjective [Latin ferrugo, rust of iron, from ferrum, iron.] 1. Partaking of iron; containing particles of iron. 2. Of the color of the rust or oxyd of iron. [Ferrugineous is less used.]
